blocks.text: Śiva Sūtras 3.26
blocks.directed: [long pause] Śiva Sūtras 3.26

blocks.text: शरीरवृत्तिर्व्रतम्
blocks.directed: [slowly] शरीरवृत्तिर्व्रतम्

blocks.text: Śarīravṛttir vratam.
blocks.directed: Śarīravṛttir vratam.

blocks.text: The continuance or activity of the body is the vow.
blocks.directed: The continuance or activity of the body is the vow.

blocks.text: Being Alive Is Your Religious Practice. Don’t Make It Weird.
blocks.directed: Being Alive Is Your Religious Practice. Don’t Make It Weird.

blocks.text: Now this is beautiful.
blocks.directed: Now this is beautiful.

blocks.text: Because we’ve reached an extraordinary transition.
blocks.directed: Because we’ve reached an extraordinary transition.

blocks.text: Earlier, the practitioner was engaged in definite practices.
blocks.directed: Earlier, the practitioner was engaged in definite practices.

blocks.text: Meditation.
blocks.directed: Meditation.

blocks.text: Concentration.
blocks.directed: Concentration.

blocks.text: Mantra.
blocks.directed: Mantra.

blocks.text: Contemplation.
blocks.directed: Contemplation.

blocks.text: The discipline of the body and senses.
blocks.directed: The discipline of the body and senses.

blocks.text: But now the yogi has become established in recognition of Śiva.
blocks.directed: But now the yogi has become established in recognition of Śiva.

blocks.text: So what becomes of religious practice?
blocks.directed: So what becomes of religious practice?

blocks.text: Vasugupta says:
blocks.directed: [short pause] Vasugupta says:

blocks.text: Śarīravṛttir vratam.
blocks.directed: Śarīravṛttir vratam.

blocks.text: The body’s continuation is the vow.
blocks.directed: The body’s continuation is the vow.

blocks.text: Let’s unpack it.
blocks.directed: Let’s unpack it.

blocks.text: Śarīra — body.
blocks.directed: Śarīra — body.

blocks.text: Vṛtti — activity, functioning, continuation, maintenance.
blocks.directed: Vṛtti — activity, functioning, continuation, maintenance.

blocks.text: Vrata — vow, religious observance, sacred discipline.
blocks.directed: Vrata — vow, religious observance, sacred discipline.

blocks.text: And Kṣemarāja gives a specific explanation.
blocks.directed: And Kṣemarāja gives a specific explanation.

blocks.text: The liberated yogi remains embodied.
blocks.directed: The liberated yogi remains embodied.

blocks.text: They continue to experience the circumstances of bodily existence.
blocks.directed: They continue to experience the circumstances of bodily existence.

blocks.text: And the continuation of that body becomes their sacred observance.
blocks.directed: And the continuation of that body becomes their sacred observance.

blocks.text: Now this is not an invitation to do whatever you like and call it Tantra.
blocks.directed: Now this is not an invitation to do whatever you like and call it Tantra.

blocks.text: That’s a misunderstanding worth preventing immediately.
blocks.directed: That’s a misunderstanding worth preventing immediately.

blocks.text: The sūtra does not mean that every impulse of the body automatically constitutes enlightened conduct.
blocks.directed: The sūtra does not mean that every impulse of the body automatically constitutes enlightened conduct.

blocks.text: Nor does it abolish responsibility for harmful action.
blocks.directed: Nor does it abolish responsibility for harmful action.

blocks.text: Kṣemarāja is describing the condition of a yogi whose identity is already established in the supreme reality.
blocks.directed: Kṣemarāja is describing the condition of a yogi whose identity is already established in the supreme reality.

blocks.text: Their life has become inseparable from their recognition of Śiva.
blocks.directed: Their life has become inseparable from their recognition of Śiva.

blocks.text: And therefore the ordinary continuation of embodiment is no longer fundamentally separate from worship.
blocks.directed: And therefore the ordinary continuation of embodiment is no longer fundamentally separate from worship.

blocks.text: Think about the conventional structure of a religious vow.
blocks.directed: Think about the conventional structure of a religious vow.

blocks.text: You undertake a particular discipline.
blocks.directed: You undertake a particular discipline.

blocks.text: Perhaps fasting.
blocks.directed: Perhaps fasting.

blocks.text: Perhaps recitation.
blocks.directed: Perhaps recitation.

blocks.text: Perhaps a form of worship.
blocks.directed: Perhaps a form of worship.

blocks.text: You establish a special period or activity dedicated to the divine.
blocks.directed: You establish a special period or activity dedicated to the divine.

blocks.text: There’s ordinary life.
blocks.directed: There’s ordinary life.

blocks.text: And then there’s the vow.
blocks.directed: And then there’s the vow.

blocks.text: But Kṣemarāja describes a state in which that separation has been transformed.
blocks.directed: But Kṣemarāja describes a state in which that separation has been transformed.

blocks.text: The yogi remains devoted to the supreme consciousness through the very continuation of embodied existence.
blocks.directed: The yogi remains devoted to the supreme consciousness through the very continuation of embodied existence.

blocks.text: Living itself becomes a sacred expression.
blocks.directed: Living itself becomes a sacred expression.

blocks.text: And the commentary explicitly mentions the traditional understanding that the remaining circumstances of embodiment are allowed to run their course.
blocks.directed: And the commentary explicitly mentions the traditional understanding that the remaining circumstances of embodiment are allowed to run their course.

blocks.text: The yogi doesn’t have to destroy the body.
blocks.directed: The yogi doesn’t have to destroy the body.

blocks.text: Or treat bodily survival as a spiritual failure.
blocks.directed: Or treat bodily survival as a spiritual failure.

blocks.text: Kṣemarāja also invokes a tantric analogy involving fire, vital energy and the Self, in which the embodied condition is related to the attainment of supreme Śiva.
blocks.directed: Kṣemarāja also invokes a tantric analogy involving fire, vital energy and the Self, in which the embodied condition is related to the attainment of supreme Śiva.

blocks.text: And he draws on the Trikasāra tradition to explain how ordinary bodily and ritual activity can be transformed through recognition. Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.
blocks.directed: And he draws on the Trikasāra tradition to explain how ordinary bodily and ritual activity can be transformed through recognition. Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.

blocks.text: Now, here’s what I find particularly beautiful.
blocks.directed: Now, here’s what I find particularly beautiful.

blocks.text: The yogi has ceased to regard the body as the ultimate Self.
blocks.directed: The yogi has ceased to regard the body as the ultimate Self.

blocks.text: But that doesn’t make the body worthless.
blocks.directed: But that doesn’t make the body worthless.

blocks.text: The body becomes an expression within consciousness.
blocks.directed: The body becomes an expression within consciousness.

blocks.text: And therefore its continued activity can be understood through its divine source.
blocks.directed: And therefore its continued activity can be understood through its divine source.

blocks.text: This is an enormously affirmative position.
blocks.directed: This is an enormously affirmative position.

blocks.text: It’s not:
blocks.directed: [short pause] It’s not:

blocks.text: “My body is disgusting, and I must escape it.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “My body is disgusting, and I must escape it.”

blocks.text: Nor:
blocks.directed: [short pause] Nor:

blocks.text: “My body is the supreme and complete identity.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “My body is the supreme and complete identity.”

blocks.text: It’s:
blocks.directed: [short pause] It’s:

blocks.text: “My body is a manifestation of consciousness, and its activity can occur without obscuring the recognition of that consciousness.”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “My body is a manifestation of consciousness, and its activity can occur without obscuring the recognition of that consciousness.”

blocks.text: And this creates an extraordinary possibility.
blocks.directed: And this creates an extraordinary possibility.

blocks.text: Eating can become an expression of sacred life.
blocks.directed: Eating can become an expression of sacred life.

blocks.text: Walking.
blocks.directed: Walking.

blocks.text: Resting.
blocks.directed: Resting.

blocks.text: Breathing.
blocks.directed: Breathing.

blocks.text: Speaking.
blocks.directed: Speaking.

blocks.text: Acting.
blocks.directed: Acting.

blocks.text: Not because each activity automatically produces liberation.
blocks.directed: Not because each activity automatically produces liberation.

blocks.text: But because the liberated yogi is no longer fundamentally estranged from the divine nature of manifestation.
blocks.directed: But because the liberated yogi is no longer fundamentally estranged from the divine nature of manifestation.

blocks.text: The life itself becomes permeated by recognition.
blocks.directed: The life itself becomes permeated by recognition.

blocks.text: And here’s the lovely reversal.
blocks.directed: And here’s the lovely reversal.

blocks.text: Earlier, bodily identification was a central aspect of bondage.
blocks.directed: Earlier, bodily identification was a central aspect of bondage.

blocks.text: Now bodily continuation is a vow.
blocks.directed: Now bodily continuation is a vow.

blocks.text: Same body.
blocks.directed: Same body.

blocks.text: Different standpoint.
blocks.directed: Different standpoint.

blocks.text: The body that once seemed to imprison consciousness becomes the field through which its freedom is expressed.
blocks.directed: The body that once seemed to imprison consciousness becomes the field through which its freedom is expressed.

blocks.text: And this prepares us for one of the most wonderful sūtras in the entire work.
blocks.directed: And this prepares us for one of the most wonderful sūtras in the entire work.

blocks.text: Because Vasugupta now extends the same transformation to speech.
blocks.directed: Because Vasugupta now extends the same transformation to speech.

blocks.text: And the result is absolutely hilarious when translated literally.
blocks.directed: And the result is absolutely hilarious when translated literally.

blocks.text: Conversation becomes mantra-recitation.
blocks.directed: Conversation becomes mantra-recitation.

blocks.text: Which means that apparently the enlightened yogi can go down to the market, ask for some vegetables, and still be engaged in worship.
blocks.directed: Which means that apparently the enlightened yogi can go down to the market, ask for some vegetables, and still be engaged in worship.

blocks.text: Now that’s efficient.
blocks.directed: Now that’s efficient.
